title: [Dev] Can't click to delete carb entries without clicking inside checkbox
symptom: In the carb entry list, clicking on a row does not delete the entry; the user must click inside the checkbox to delete. This issue is present in Master and Dev.
fix: The thread references two commits that address the issue: b8f4cf8606a687bf65cbdce45f5842025fcaf7c1 and 72e44ebe620d3a7324b8b6e5f9260716a64f9787. The first commit allowed selection by clicking the row, but deletion still failed; the second commit presumably fixed the deletion.
evidence_quote: I can select it now, but entry isn't deleted. See video below.
